_comment: The core-declared file form for chimera's project wizard: a PS3 project is one game, either a homebrew executable booted directly or a disc image with its key.

slots.title: Game
slots.help: A PS3 executable (.elf, .self, EBOOT.BIN) booted directly the way a modded console would, or a disc image (.iso): a decrypted image, or a Redump image with its disc key in the Disc key slot.

slots.title: Disc key
slots.help: The 32-character disc key that decrypts a Redump PS3 image (the .dkey file distributed alongside it). Not needed for a decrypted image or a homebrew executable.
